archetypes.name: path-reader-audit
archetypes.rationale: The plan says it updates 'all readers' of the three relocated paths, but only enumerates step2-implement.sh, launch-codex-implement.sh, step-7a.sh, and the two harnesses — any other consumer that hardcodes the old paths (manifest.json, qa-pending.json, transcript) directly in $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR will silently break.
archetypes.prompt_body: Search the full codebase for every reference to the three artifact names being relocated: manifest.json, qa-pending.json, and the codex-impl-transcript pattern. For each hit outside the five files the plan explicitly enumerates (step2-implement.sh, launch-codex-implement.sh, step-7a.sh, test-codex-implementer.sh, test-step2-dispatch.sh), determine whether it reads from or writes to the path at $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR directly rather than through a passed variable, and whether the plan's update set covers the reference. Also verify that the .meta.trimmed and .prompt sidecar files (derived from the transcript path in step-7a.sh lines 87-89 in the plan) are fully updated in every reference, not just the base transcript. Flag any reference the plan omits as a gap. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
